title: Compact-support projection maps commute with etale exchange
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to S$ be a compactifiable morphism between Noetherian schemes [def-asd-compactifiable]. Let $v:S'\to S$ be a morphism with Noetherian $S'$, and form $X'=X\times_S S'$ with maps $v_X:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$, using a compactification of $f$ and its base change. Work in the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact inverse images and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For arbitrary $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $Q\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, write $b_M:v^*Rf_!M\to Rf'_!v_X^*M$, with $Rf_!$ and $Rf'_!$ the compact direct images of these compactifications [def-amb-etale-compact-support], for the compactification-defined exchange (the proper ordinary unit--square--counit exchange [sbc-def-base-change-map] followed by extension-by-zero base change [sbc-prop-extension-by-zero-and-arbitrary-base-change]). Write $\Pi_{f,Q,M}:Q\otimes_A^L Rf_!M\to Rf_!(f^*Q\otimes_A^L M)$ for the canonical compact-support projection map, constructed by the proper counit-defined projection map [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection] and the extension-by-zero tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor]. Then
$$b_{f^*Q\otimes_A^L M}\circ v^*(\Pi_{f,Q,M})=\Pi_{f',v^*Q,v_X^*M}\circ(1_{v^*Q}\otimes b_M),$$
after identifying the source $v^*(Q\otimes_A^L Rf_!M)$ with $v^*Q\otimes_A^L v^*Rf_!M$ and the target using $v_X^*f^*Q\cong f'^*v^*Q$. No boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.
